== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Weapon Levitation & The Empire's Back (Errata)]] (<code>1261_48</code>, Virtual Block 6 slip 51), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-51-Weapon_Levitation_The_Empires_Back.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-weaponlevitation&theempiresback-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Weapon Levitation & The Empire's Back]]; the Master List (2013) reprints the original.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “USED: Cancel Disarmed or Wookie Strangle. OR Once per battle involving Vader, reveal a device or character weapon from Used Pile and add its printed destiny number to your total power; reshuffle. LOST: Use 1 Force to ▼ (or retrieve) Vader. OR If opponent just initiated a battle against Vader defending alone at a site, his forfeit cannot be reduced.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1261_48</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 6 set mark, slip number 51, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-51-Weapon_Levitation_The_Empires_Back-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B26 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
